text: Praise the LORD! You who serve the LORD — praise! Praise the LORD’s name!
Let the LORD’s name be blessed from now until forever from now!
From sunrise to sunset, let the LORD’s name be praised!
The LORD is high over all the nations; God’s glory is higher than the skies!
Who could possibly compare to the LORD our God? God rules from on high;
he has to come down to even see heaven and earth!
God lifts up the poor from the dirt and raises up the needy from the garbage pile
to seat them with leaders — with the leaders of his own people!
God nests the once barren woman at home — now a joyful mother with children! Praise the LORD!
